description: This file defines classes and objects related to RPC timeout handling in Apache Spark, including custom exceptions, timeout configuration, and utility methods for managing timeouts in asynchronous operations.

classes.name: RpcTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception extending TimeoutException, used when RPC timeout occurs.

classes.name: RpcTimeout
classes.description: Class representing a timeout with associated configuration property, providing methods to handle timeout exceptions and await results.

methods.name: createRpcTimeoutException
methods.description: Creates an RpcTimeoutException with a message including the timeout property.

methods.name: addMessageIfTimeout
methods.description: PartialFunction to add context to TimeoutExceptions, converting them to RpcTimeoutException.

methods.name: awaitResult
methods.description: Waits for a Future to complete within the specified timeout, throwing RpcTimeoutException on timeout.
